I can do that, as long as the team lead covers the front desk.

audio.text: Rachel, I'm updating the shipping policy on our website. Do you remember what we decided about international orders?
We said they'd ship free if the total is over one hundred and fifty dollars, but otherwise the customer pays.
Seven to ten business days. I wouldn't promise anything shorter, because customs can hold packages.
Fine. Should I mention returns as well?
Yes, but briefly. Customers have thirty days, and we cover the return fee only if the item is damaged.
Got it. I'll send you the draft after lunch.
